headlines.description: — Bennedict Mathurin scored 28 points, John Collins 22 and Kawhi Leonard 20 as the Los Angeles Clippers got past the short-handed Milwaukee Bucks 127-113 on Sunday for their fifth consecutive win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mathurin scores 28 to pace Clippers past short-handed Bucks 127-113

headlines.description: — Pascal Siakam scored 30 points and Micah Potter added 21 and tied a career high with five 3-pointers to help the Indiana Pacers get past the Miami Heat for a rare...
headlines.shortLinkText: Pascal Siakam scores 30 points to give Pacers 135-118 victory that adds to Heat's struggles

headlines.description: — Ochai Agbaji scored 18 points in 25 minutes off the bench and the Brooklyn Nets snapped a 10-game losing streak with a 116-99 win over the Sacramento Kings on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nets rout Kings 116-99 to end 10-game losing streak

headlines.description: — Jayson Tatum scored 32 points, Payton Pritchard added 28 points and the Boston Celtics defeated the cold-shooting Charlotte Hornets 114-99 on Sunday night for their third straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jayson Tatum, Payton Pritchard help push Celtics past the Hornets 114-99

headlines.description: — RJ Barrett scored 24 points, Scottie Barnes had 23 points and a career-high 15 assists, and the Toronto Raptors used a 31-point run to rout Orlando 139-87 on Sunday night, handing the slumping Magic their seventh loss in eight games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barnes has career-high 15 assists, Raptors score 31 straight points to rout slumping Magic 139-87

events.name: Washington Wizards at Portland Trail Blazers

headlines.description: — Toumani Camara scored 23 points and the Portland Trail Blazers routed the Washington Wizards 123-88 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Camara has 23 for the Trail Blazers in 123-88 rout of the Wizards

events.name: Houston Rockets at New Orleans Pelicans

headlines.description: — Alperen Sengun had 36 points, 13 rebounds and seven assists Sunday night, Houston dominated the second quarter, and the Rockets beat the New Orleans Pelicans 134-102.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alperen Sengun has 36 points, 13 rebounds, 7 assists as Rockets beat Pelicans 134-102

events.name: New York Knicks at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 30 points, including 10 in the fourth quarter, and the Oklahoma City Thunder defeated the New York Knicks 111-100 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gilgeous-Alexander scores 30 points and finishes strong as Thunder beat Knicks 111-100

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Denver Nuggets

headlines.description: — Nikola Jokic had 25 points and 15 rebounds, Jamal Murray had 20 points, and the surging Denver Nuggets beat the short-handed Golden State Warriors 116-93 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jokic has 25 points, 15 rebounds, Nuggets beat Warriors 116-93 for their 6th straight win
